what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Tanzania in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 207 Tanzanian asylum seekers in South Africa, 7.5% of all asylum seekers from Tanzania.
Refugees from Tanzania, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany and Sweden.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Tanzania: with the Islamic State group in 2020.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Tanzania.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 550 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 4981, at the end of 2005; the main years of displacement in the data are 2003 to 2005 and 2007 to 2008.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
